name: JV_STAKEHOLDERS_B_
description: This table contains the stakeholders associated with a joint venture.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each partner record associated with a joint venture.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The short name of the stakeholder. This value must be unique.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: The joint venture ID from the JV_JOINT_VENTURES_B table.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party ID for the partner. For invoicing partner it will be respective customer or supplier party id. For cost center it will be user entered party id.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the stakeholder. Possible statuses defined in the JV STAKEHOLDER STATUS lookup may include ACTIVE,INACTIVE,ETC.

columns.name: INVOICING_PARTNER_ID
columns.description: The invoicing partner ID from the JV_INVOICING_PARTNERS_B table.

columns.name: COST_CENTER_SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: The cost center associated with the chart of accounts that is associated with the joint venture.

columns.name: INTERNAL_STAKEHOLDER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder is an internal or external partner. A status of "Y" indicates the partner is internal. A status of "N" indicates the partner is external.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_TYPE
columns.description: The type of stakeholder. It is based on the JV STAKEHOLDER TYPE lookup codes like BALANCING INTEREST OWNER,MEMO-OWNER,etc.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the joint venture stakeholder is only participating in the transaction distribution and not being invoiced.

columns.name: PARTNER_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code used to create joint venture invoices for the partner.

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the classification of a stakeholder as an operator or a non-operator.

columns.name: JIB_TEMPLATE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the Joint Interest Billing report template associated with the stakeholder.

columns.name: JIB_REPORT_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: The format of the Joint Interest Billing report output associated with the stakeholder. It's based on ORA_JV_JIB_OUTPUT_FORMAT lookup codes such as ORA_JV_HTML, ORA_JV_PDF, ORA_JV_RTF, and so on.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the location associated with the party of the joint venture stakeholder.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
